rubric_items.deep_module: a finding — §8 adds a settings/precedence mechanism (flag, three env vars, home-derived defaults, bundle role, `config` view) but names no module or function that owns the resolution, and leaves the seam by which the home-derived map default reaches `discover_bundles` undescribed, so the complexity lands on whichever of cli.py, machine_map.py and the writer the implementer picks.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §8 resolves the EDDB cache root through `resolve_description_store_root`, whose name, docstring ("Resolve a declared store-root name") and refusal text are the *description-store* owner, so a cache role resolved through it gives the mechanism a second, mis-named meaning; and §8's home-derived map default risks a second map-search owner beside `discover_bundles` unless the plan names how the derived root is handed to that one owner. A third, external fact: §7's rename is already on `main`.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §8 carries an explicit interface account that names, per addition, what it retires (`IMAS_ALAMBIC_HOME` retires §4's `env.sh`; `IMAS_ALAMBIC_IDS_ROOT` retires `--out` as required; `--maps/--out/--cache` are flag forms of the same three settings; `--run` and `config` state why nothing can be retired), §7 states its rename adds no command or option, and §9 states the `machine` key retires nothing because single-machine addressing never existed.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan searched the repository it extends and cites the mechanism each section edits, and its §1 census reproduces exactly: `git grep -l -E "jt-60sa|JT60SA_ROOT|JT60SA_DESCRIPTION_DIR|/work/projects/imas_gpu/jt60sa" -- imas_ambix scripts tests packages ':!*.json'` returns the same 20 files the plan lists, and §9's three named edit sites (`MapBundle.machine_map_path`/`signal_map_path`, `load_bundle_descriptor`) are the only structure builders.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the sections that touch existing code extend it rather than wrapping it: §8 widens `discover_bundles` and `resolve_description_store_root`, §9 widens `MapBundle`/`load_bundle_descriptor`, and §7 is a rename that adds no layer; §5's `install/imasdb.sh` is deployment shell, not a wrapper over engine machinery.
